name: linkzly
description: Integrate the Linkzly SDKs correctly in mobile apps (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter) and websites (JavaScript): install, events, purchases, deep links and smart links, push and attribution.

interface.shortDescription: Linkzly mobile and web SDK integration
interface.longDescription: Add the Linkzly SDK to an iOS, Android, React Native or Flutter app: install and configuration, custom events, purchases and refunds, deep links, push tokens, affiliate attribution and privacy controls, with rules for the SDK behaviours that are easy to get wrong. Or add the Linkzly Web SDK to a website: npm or script-tag install, custom events and page views, purchases, smart link and UTM attribution, and consent.
defaultPrompt: Add the Linkzly SDK to this app and track a sign-up event
Add the Linkzly Web SDK to this website and track a sign-up event
Track purchases and refunds in this app with the Linkzly SDK
My Linkzly events are not showing up; find out why
